name: Mento Canadian Dollar
oneLiner: CADm is Mento's reserve-backed Canadian dollar stablecoin on Celo, issued and retired through the oracle-priced USDm/CADm Broker pool.
collateral: Shared Mento Reserve: Mento's pinned analytics configuration classifies CADm as reserve-backed rather than CDP-backed. Its backing is the protocol's diversified, dynamically managed reserve, not USDm locked in a CADm-specific borrower trove.
pegMechanism: CADm is issued through Mento v2's USDm/CADm Broker and BiPoolManager exchange. A USDm-to-CADm swap burns incoming USDm and mints outgoing CADm; the reverse burns CADm and mints USDm. The virtual pool prices swaps from the CAD/USD SortedOracles feed and applies spread, trading-limit, report-count, freshness, and BreakerBox checks.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: CADm remains a legacy Mento V2 shared-reserve token. MGP-18 (August 17, 2026) explicitly lists AUDm and CADm among the FX tokens not yet migrated to CDPs and states that their USDm pools stay live for holder redemption. At Celo block 78972424, the canonical Broker recognizes the BiPoolManager provider and quotes a CADm-to-USDm swap; verified Broker source burns the input stable asset and mints the output stable asset. The issuer backing configuration independently identifies shared diversified crypto reserve backing. This resolves the operational holder exit model but establishes neither a custodial fiat claim nor borrower-specific CDP. Keep D18 unresolved until a uniform owner-approved shared-reserve mechanism mapping exists; no protective grade is inferred.

sources.label: MGP-18: exact legacy FX token redemption and non-CDP status
